tools.name: extract_method
tools.description: Extract selected code into a new private method

sourceCode.description: The complete C# source code containing the code to extract

startLine.description: The starting line number of the code block to extract (1-based)

endLine.description: The ending line number of the code block to extract (inclusive, 1-based)

newMethodName.description: The name for the new extracted method

tools.name: constructor_injection
tools.description: Convert method parameters to constructor-injected fields or properties

className.description: The name of the class to modify

methodName.description: The name of the method containing parameters to inject

parameterNames.description: Comma or semicolon-separated list of parameter names to inject

useProperties.description: If true, create properties instead of fields (optional, default: false)

tools.name: make_field_readonly
tools.description: Make fields readonly where safe (only assigned in constructors)

className.description: The name of the class containing fields

fieldName.description: Optional specific field name, or omit to analyze all fields

tools.name: safe_delete_method
tools.description: Delete methods with reference checking to ensure safe deletion

className.description: The name of the class containing the method

methodName.description: The name of the method to delete

tools.name: extract_class
tools.description: Extract fields and methods into a new class with composition pattern

className.description: The name of the class to extract from

newClassName.description: The name for the new extracted class

memberNames.description: Comma or semicolon-separated list of member names (fields/methods) to extract

tools.name: remove_unused_usings
tools.description: Remove unused using directives with framework-aware global using preservation

tools.name: inline_method
tools.description: Inline a method by replacing its single invocation with the method body (Part 1: void methods, simple parameters, single caller)

className.description: The name of the class containing the method

methodName.description: The name of the method to inline

tools.name: rename_symbol
tools.description: Renames a symbol (local variable, parameter, private field, or private method) at a specific position. Uses position-based resolution for precise symbol identification. Updates all references within the same file. ⚠️ LIMITATION: Single-file scope only. Cannot rename public/protected members or symbols used across multiple files.

lineNumber.description: The 1-based line number of the symbol to rename

columnNumber.description: The 1-based column number of the symbol to rename

newName.description: The new identifier name (must be a valid C# identifier)

tools.name: fix_diagnostic
tools.description: Automatically fixes a specific Roslyn diagnostic by applying the appropriate refactoring. Supports: IDE0005/CS8019 (unused usings), IDE0044 (readonly fields). Framework-aware: applies fixes according to target framework capabilities.

sourceCode.description: The complete C# source code containing the diagnostic

diagnosticId.description: The Roslyn diagnostic ID to fix (e.g., 'IDE0005', 'IDE0044', 'CS8019')

line.description: The line number where the diagnostic occurs (1-based)

column.description: The column number where the diagnostic occurs (1-based)

tools.name: inline_variable
tools.description: Inlines a variable by replacing all its uses with its initialization expression, then removes the variable declaration. Maps to Roslyn diagnostics IDE0059 and IDE0058. Provide the source code, line and column position (1-based) of the variable declaration, and optionally target framework (defaults to net8.0).

lineNumber.description: The line number (1-based) where the variable is declared

columnNumber.description: The column number (1-based) within the line

tools.name: analyze_code
tools.description: Analyzes C# code for compiler warnings, style violations, and code quality issues using Roslyn diagnostics with full IDE analyzer support (IDE0001-IDE9999). Detects unused usings (IDE0005), readonly fields (IDE0044), code style issues, and more. Returns a list of issues with their locations, severity levels, and applicable refactorings. Framework-aware: analyzes code according to target framework capabilities.

sourceCode.description: The complete C# source code to analyze
